title: Follow the Arrows Far
statement:
There are `n` stations. From station `i` an arrow leads to station `f_i` (possibly itself). You get `q` queries, each with a station `v` and a number `k`: start at `v` and follow the arrows `k` times. Print the station where you end up, one answer per line.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `q`. The second line contains `f_1 ... f_n`. Each of the next `q` lines contains `v` and `k`.

## Output
Print `q` lines, the answer to each query.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 10000`
- `1 <= q <= 4000`
- `1 <= f_i, v <= n`
- `0 <= k <= 10^18`
